svg.title: Compare Earned Fee Yield, Not Escrow Throughput
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-funding-lane-earned-fee-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Earned Fee Yield, Not Escrow Throughput; subtitle: Five hypothetical lane quotes express operator fees as a percentage of $100,000 deployed principal.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are fee-yield percentage points per deployment, not annual returns or net margins. Each example assumes $100,000 principal and a 72-hour exposure solely to standardize comparison. Prices are editorial assumptions, not market benchmarks or recommended charges. Payment rails do not themselves create yield. These unit examples are separate from the annual Base-Case cohort and must not be summed into its $535,000 revenue.; caption: Fee yield = earned operator fee ÷ deployed principal × 100. A 1.25% fee produces $1,250 revenue, not $101,250. Applicable charge limits, minimum bank charges, capital carry, and failed-closing losses determine whether any quote is usable.; stages: label: Complex double-close through Fedwire; value: $1,250 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 1.25; detail: Assume a hypothetical 1.25% fee for a document-intensive 72-hour double close. Both closing legs must be executable, buyer cash unconditional, and the beneficiary verified. Complexity does not excuse an impermissible charge.; label: Repeat-borrower double-close through Fedwire; value: $1,000 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Assume a hypothetical 1.00% fee where reusable entity records reduce intake work. Reconfirm bank coordinates and available buyer cash for every transaction; a repeat relationship never substitutes for wire authentication.; label: Escrow-controlled EMD JV allocation; value: $800 operator allocation per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 0.8; detail: Assume a hypothetical 0.80% earned operator allocation on a 72-hour escrow-controlled transaction. Reject early EMD requests lacking unconditional end-buyer cash under this desk's mandate. A JV label does not settle whether lending rules apply.; label: Same-bank commercial escrow transfer; value: $600 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 0.6; detail: Assume a hypothetical 0.60% fee and confirmed settlement-agent acceptance of an internal bank transfer. Verify funds availability and the legal beneficiary; a same-bank route does not eliminate mistaken-recipient or fraudulent-instruction risk.; label: Issuer-permitted credit-funded escrow wire; value: $400 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 0.4; detail: Assume a hypothetical 0.40% fee only where the issuer expressly permits the actual credit-to-cash transaction and the settlement agent accepts its documented source. Do not treat a 0%-APR purchase promotion as cash-advance pricing or use fabricated merchant purchases. Deduct transfer fees and actual borrowing charges separately.

text.title: Compare Earned Fee Yield, Not Escrow Throughput
text.tspan: Compare Earned Fee Yield, Not Escrow Throughput

rect.title: label: Complex double-close through Fedwire; value: $1,250 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 1.25; detail: Assume a hypothetical 1.25% fee for a document-intensive 72-hour double close. Both closing legs must be executable, buyer cash unconditional, and the beneficiary verified. Complexity does not excuse an impermissible charge.

label: Repeat-borrower double-close through Fedwire; value: $1,000 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Assume a hypothetical 1.00% fee where reusable entity records reduce intake work. Reconfirm bank coordinates and available buyer cash for every transaction; a repeat relationship never substitutes for wire authentication.

label: Escrow-controlled EMD JV allocation; value: $800 operator allocation per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 0.8; detail: Assume a hypothetical 0.80% earned operator allocation on a 72-hour escrow-controlled transaction. Reject early EMD requests lacking unconditional end-buyer cash under this desk's mandate. A JV label does not settle whether lending rules apply.

label: Same-bank commercial escrow transfer; value: $600 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 0.6; detail: Assume a hypothetical 0.60% fee and confirmed settlement-agent acceptance of an internal bank transfer. Verify funds availability and the legal beneficiary; a same-bank route does not eliminate mistaken-recipient or fraudulent-instruction risk.

label: Issuer-permitted credit-funded escrow wire; value: $400 earned fee per $100,000 deployed principal.; numeric value: 0.4; detail: Assume a hypothetical 0.40% fee only where the issuer expressly permits the actual credit-to-cash transaction and the settlement agent accepts its documented source. Do not treat a 0%-APR purchase promotion as cash-advance pricing or use fabricated merchant purchases. Deduct transfer fees and actual borrowing charges separately.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are fee-yield percentage points per deployment, not annual returns or net margins. Each example assumes $100,000 principal and a 72-hour exposure solely to standardize comparison. Prices are editorial assumptions, not market benchmarks or recommended charges. Payment rails do not themselves create yield. These unit examples are separate from the annual Base-Case cohort and must not be summed into its $535,000 revenue.
